question: What is the status of Shiva-tattva relative to the rest of the path?
premises: Beyond the preceding levels is the pure, supreme Shiva principle.
From water onward up to Shiva-tattva, none but Shiva has seen it.
inference: Therefore Shiva-tattva transcends the measurable path and is known directly only by Shiva.
uncertainties: The scope of 'seen' may include both direct vision and full knowledge.
plain_english: Beyond all that is the pure, supreme, immeasurable Shiva principle; from water up to Shiva-tattva, no one but Shiva has truly seen it.
